info.name: F&B HQ API
info.description: Health, outlets, master menu, assignments, inventory, outlet menu, sales, reports, live events (SSE). Run top to bottom (Collection Runner) — later requests use ids saved by earlier ones. Each run creates new test rows (no DELETE API by design). Deselect folder 9 (SSE stream, never ends) in the Runner and send it by hand. Needs the seed (npm run db:seed) for DHA/GUL/UTT checks.

item.name: 4. Inventory
item.description:
Rules 11–16: stock per item, restock (+q), adjust (absolute, delta logged), logs newest first. Uses the item assigned in folder 3 (starts at stock 0).

Endpoints used:
- GET /api/hq/outlets/:outletId/inventory — Stock per assigned item
- POST /api/hq/outlets/:outletId/inventory/:menuItemId/restock — Add stock (RESTOCK log)
- PUT /api/hq/outlets/:outletId/inventory/:menuItemId — Set absolute stock (ADJUSTMENT log)
- GET /api/hq/outlets/:outletId/inventory/:menuItemId/logs — Stock movement history, newest first

exec: pm.test("assigned item listed with quantity 0", () => { const r = pm.response.json().data.find(x => x.menuItemId === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("menuItemId"))); pm.expect(r.quantity).to.eql(0); });

request.description:
**POST /api/hq/outlets/:outletId/inventory/:menuItemId/restock** — Add stock (RESTOCK log)

Rule 14: atomic increment + RESTOCK log; balanceAfter comes from the DB.

exec: pm.test("RESTOCK log +10 / 10", () => { const l = pm.response.json().data.log; pm.expect([l.changeType, l.quantityChange, l.balanceAfter, l.note]).to.eql(["RESTOCK", 10, 10, "Morning delivery"]); });

item.name: Adjust stock — set to 4 (stock count) → 200, ADJUSTMENT log

request.description:
**PUT /api/hq/outlets/:outletId/inventory/:menuItemId** — Set absolute stock (ADJUSTMENT log)

Rule 15: absolute value; logged delta = new − old = −6.

exec: pm.test("ADJUSTMENT log −6 / 4", () => { const l = pm.response.json().data.log; pm.expect([l.changeType, l.quantityChange, l.balanceAfter]).to.eql(["ADJUSTMENT", -6, 4]); });

item.name: Adjust stock — same value → 200, no log
Get stock logs — newest first, Σ = stock → 200

request.description:
**GET /api/hq/outlets/:outletId/inventory/:menuItemId/logs** — Stock movement history, newest first

Invariant: sum of quantityChange = current quantity (4).

exec: pm.test("2 logs, newest first", () => { pm.expect(logs.map(l => l.changeType)).to.eql(["ADJUSTMENT", "RESTOCK"]); });
pm.test("Σ quantityChange = 4", () => { pm.expect(logs.reduce((s, l) => s + l.quantityChange, 0)).to.eql(4); });

Rule 31: top 5 per outlet (ROW_NUMBER() OVER PARTITION BY outlet). Ties: revenue desc, then name.

exec: pm.test("items sorted: qty desc, revenue desc, name asc", () => d.forEach((o) => { for (let i = 1; i < o.items.length; i++) { const a = o.items[i - 1], b = o.items[i]; const ok = a.qtySold > b.qtySold || (a.qtySold === b.qtySold && (Number(a.revenue) > Number(b.revenue) || (a.revenue === b.revenue && a.name <= b.name))); pm.expect(ok, `${a.name} before ${b.name}`).to.be.true; } }));

9. Live events (SSE)
item.description:
Server-Sent Events stream for HQ screens.

Endpoints used:
- GET /api/hq/events — live sale.created events

**Send manually. Deselect this folder in the Collection Runner:** the stream never ends, so the Runner would wait forever.

item.name: Live events stream — open, then make a sale

request.description:
**GET /api/hq/events** — Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream)

1. Send this request. The stream stays open and shows `retry: 5000` and `: connected`.
2. Create a sale (folder 6, e.g. the first POST /sales) in another tab.
3. The stream receives:

```
event: sale.created
data: {"outletId":1,"receiptNo":"DHA-000001"}
```

No event for an idempotent replay (same clientId → 200) or a failed sale (409/400/404). A `: heartbeat` comment arrives every 25 s. Cancel the request to disconnect.

CLI alternative: `curl -N {{baseUrl}}/api/hq/events`
